data.title: A poll: would an archaeological amnesty make sense?
data.excerpt: Views are sometimes voiced that it might help if the state declared a kind of archaeological amnesty for a limited time, allowing people to hand in archaeological finds they keep at home without being punished for it. Opinions differ on whether such an amnesty would make sense and what form it should take, so we have set up a small anonymous poll.
data.metaTitle: A poll: an archaeological amnesty for finders?
data.metaDescription: Would a temporary archaeological amnesty help people hand in the archaeological finds they keep at home without punishment? A small anonymous poll.

children.text: Views are sometimes voiced that it might help if the state were to declare, for a limited time, say 3 months, a kind of
(on the model of the well-known weapons amnesty), under which it would be possible
for people to hand in, without being punished, archaeological finds

that they keep hidden at home for various reasons (they found them by chance in the woods, by chance during building work, in the attic, left behind by their parents, or deliberately as metal detectorists). In this way it would be possible to document and save some of the finds that today are hidden from the eyes of specialists often only because their owners are afraid that they could be penalised for handing them in.
There are, however, differing views on whether such an amnesty would make sense, and also on what form it should take, that is, whether it could also be joined by
people who want to keep the finds
, but would be willing to lend them for the purposes of scientific study, or only by people who would subsequently
hand the finds over to a museum

I have decided to create a small ANONYMOUS poll, in which we would like to find out whether the people concerned would be interested in such an amnesty, and if so, what form it should take. The poll is on our website in the left-hand column.
If you have any finds at home, whether found by chance or deliberately, for instance with a detector
, I would be interested in your opinion on this subject. Cast your vote, it is anonymous.
